pr_title: Fix HMR failure with js error on load, take 2
pr_body:
# ↪️ Pull Request

See example.

I'm not sure if my changes have some side effect?
*Might* have a negative effect on scope-hoisting build sizes.

Fixes #879, previous attempt: #898

## 💻 Examples
On first load:
```js
throw new Error("STOP");

console.log("test");
```
Removing the Error line doesn't hmr successfully.

## ✔️ PR Todo

- [x] Added/updated unit tests for this change
- [x] Filled out test instructions (In case there aren't any unit tests)
- [x] Included links to related issues/PRs

review_comments: This seems dangerous. Why are we overwriting the global variable here? Won't that already happen when the function returns?

Because returning doesn't work if an error is thrown and `parcelRequire` is then undefined for subsequent HMR updates

https://github.com/parcel-bundler/parcel/blob/75a71be0abe5082ca759680217ac128d2779b97d/packages/core/parcel-bundler/src/builtins/prelude.js#L114-L121

And this overwrites a global variable as well: 
https://github.com/parcel-bundler/parcel/blob/75a71be0abe5082ca759680217ac128d2779b97d/packages/core/parcel-bundler/src/builtins/prelude.js#L10
